Question: I have had adream that my father ( HE IS ACTUALLY MY GUARDIAN ) was sick and I was very anxious about him, Please interpret this dream for me I will be highly thanks full to you. Answer ID: 31604 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 831/537/H=1432) You will have the chance and blessing of good conduct and service towards your parents, in-sha-Allah.
